avalancheActivity.comment: The avalanche danger will be concentrated only in the highest elevations of the Tatra Mountains on leeward slopes facing south to east. This will primarily occur in very steep terrain with a significant additional load. A Level 2 warning has been issued for Tuesday, November 17, 2026, for strong winds that may reach speeds of up to 25 m/s. Light snowfall is expected during the day, with up to 10 cm of new snow. Under these conditions, there will be a LOW avalanche danger.
avalancheActivity.highlights: In the highest elevations of the Tatra Mountains, small avalanches of loose and wind-drifted snow may occur under heavy additional loads.

snowpackStructure.comment: Due to warmer temperatures, the snowpack has stabilized somewhat; in many places, it has settled and hardened. In the northern sector, there is still dry, loose snow, which, combined with light snowfall and strong winds, will increase the avalanche risk.
